LESSON: DIVISIONS OF THE QUR’AN MADINAN SURAH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Modes of preservation of the Qur’an (4 lessons) By the end of the sub
Topic 1.2: Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do the divisions of the Qur’an help in studying it?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing
2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an
3. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning
4. appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: DIVISIONS OF THE QUR’AN MADINAN SURAH
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah in your own words. (skill: identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning)

Example 4: Show how “Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing.
3. Practise this skill: identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an.
4. Practise this skill: describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do the divisions of the Qur’an help in studying it?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing.
5. Be able to: identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
